artifacts.summary: Declared integration_branch and worktree_isolation in .claude-extensions.json, proved the admission gate armed via a two-arm live falsification, and recorded the maintenance obligations in docs/project-info/MAINTENANCE.md.

completion_data.completion_summary: Declared integration_branch="dev/m7-ladder-continuation" and worktree_isolation="off" in the gitignored .claude-extensions.json, confirmed the admission gate armed via a real off_integration_branch refusal and a real admit (dirty_primary_tree, accepted per plan contingency), and added a tracked ## Orchestration Branch Declaration section to docs/project-info/MAINTENANCE.md recording the re-declaration and branch-rename obligations.

memory_candidates.content: A declared integration_branch/worktree_isolation pair in .claude-extensions.json cannot be proven to have armed /orchestrate's admission gate merely by observing the disarmed-gate advisory stop printing -- an unparseable or misread manifest fails open to the same silent-undeclared state. The falsification must assert the positive signal: a deliberately wrong declared branch must produce a real off_integration_branch stop (stderr banner + stop.reason), and the correct declaration must then produce no off_integration_branch stop and no advisory line, via a --dry-run admission probe (scripts/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh --dry-run --state-file specs/state.json <task>).

A dirty_primary_tree verdict from the admission admit-arm probe is positive evidence the branch-identity test passed (that arm is only reachable after the branch test succeeds), not a failed admit -- treat it as a branch-arm PASS rather than retrying until a bare 'admit' appears, especially under a concurrent multi-task batch where a sibling's own in-scope files legitimately dirty the tree.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic batch-admission-lib.sh integration_branch semantics
sapience_notes.value: The admission consumer tests pure branch-identity equality (git symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD against the declared string), with no ancestry, descendant, or merge-target relation in the predicate. The declared value therefore names the branch the primary tree is required to sit on, not an eventual merge target -- declaring the long-lived merge target (e.g. main) instead of the active working branch would refuse nearly every ordinary invocation.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic admission gate refuse-vs-warn implementation
sapience_notes.value: The implementation offers exactly two states once integration_branch admission is wired: undeclared (one disarmed-gate advisory, neither branch nor dirty-tree arm armed) or declared (hard refuse on any branch mismatch, every cycle). There is no soft warn-only mode to select between -- accepting hard-refuse is a decision to accept the only implemented behavior, not a choice among alternatives.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic .claude-extensions.json gitignore status
sapience_notes.value: The project-root .claude-extensions.json manifest is gitignored in this repository (as is the project-root CLAUDE.md), so a hand-authored declaration added to it cannot be committed -- git-commit-scoped.sh reports a non-failure exit 8/9 skip for it rather than a commit. A fresh clone of this repository therefore starts with no declaration at all and the admission gate's disarmed-state advisory reappears until the keys are re-declared.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic maintenance-obligation siting decision
sapience_notes.value: Decided to record the integration_branch declaration's two maintenance obligations (re-declare on fresh clone; update in the same action as any working-branch rename) in the tracked docs/project-info/MAINTENANCE.md rather than beside the manifest itself or in the agent-system's own repo-level-declarations.md, because both the manifest and the project-root CLAUDE.md are gitignored (would not survive a fresh clone) and the agent-system doc is a deployed .claude/** artifact whose source store resolves to a different repository.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh warm-cache flake
sapience_notes.value: test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh's warm-cache gate-skip control case ('a genuinely matching warm-cache entry was expected to skip gate 1 but did not') failed on an otherwise-unrelated run of verify-touched.sh scoped to a pure-documentation edit, indicating a timing-sensitive assertion in that suite rather than a defect introduced by the edit under test.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic agent-system/extensions/core source_dir resolution
sapience_notes.value: This repository's deployed core extension declares source_dir as /home/benjamin/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/core (an external store), not a local agent-system/extensions/core tree under the project root. Several of this repo's own test suites (test-orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, test-postflight-deploy-gate.sh, test-redeploy-checkpoint-promotion.sh, test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh, test-deploy-root-guard.sh, test-lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh, test-routing-resolution.sh, test-source-store-path-lib.sh) hardcode a project-root-relative agent-system/extensions/... path and fail in this environment regardless of what any given task changes.
